summary: Wrote /app/bin/summarize.py, which handles all eight depot formats and the shared export conventions (gzip, BOM/charset, mid-file headers and directives, per-row units, layout switching, offsets) and applies the documented seq ordering, correction, void, resend and handover rules. It ran on /app/data to produce /app/out/summary.json, and check_summary.py reports every value matches.
